text: As the Toronto Transit Commission operates a transit service on Bayview Avenue and Sutherland Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Through the Leaside Neighbourhood Transportation Plan, Transportation Services reviewed the need for traffic control signals at the intersection of Bayview Avenue and Sutherland Drive. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services recommends the installation of traffic control signals at this intersection.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item to its November 14, 2023 meeting.
